sections.h2: Why regular mowing suits generous valley blocks
paras: Kambah is Canberra's largest suburb, and it sets the pattern for the valley: wide frontages, big back yards and kikuyu or couch lawns that put on serious growth from September. A lawn that size takes several cuts to bring back once it gets away, so a fortnightly visit is far less work than a monthly rescue.

The hillside suburbs of Fadden, Macarthur and Gilmore add sloping yards, which are harder to cut once the grass is long and wet. Isabella Plains and Bonython sit on flatter ground near the lake and the Murrumbidgee corridor, and regular lawn mowing Tuggeranong wide keeps them at a steady height that shades out bindi and broadleaf weeds.

Cold air settles in the valley, and hard frosts from May to August stop most lawns growing, so we drop to a monthly tidy through winter. From September the spring surge arrives and we move to fortnightly, which is when regular lawn mowing Tuggeranong wide matters most.

Autumn brings leaf drop from the deciduous street trees in Wanniassa, Richardson and Chisholm, and we rake, mow and remove it with the clippings. In summer we cut higher and less often so the lawn holds moisture, with water restrictions in mind.

sections.h2: How to book mowing in Tuggeranong

faqs.q: Do you cover the whole of Tuggeranong?
faqs.a: Yes. Our lawn mowing Tuggeranong service covers Kambah, Wanniassa, Greenway, Fadden, Monash, Gowrie, Isabella Plains, Richardson, Chisholm, Macarthur, Gilmore and Bonython. Nature strips can be included in the visit, and we edge along the kerb and footpath.

faqs.q: Can you mow a sloping yard in Fadden or Macarthur?
faqs.a: Yes. Sloping blocks are common in the hillside suburbs and we cut them right through the season. We mow across the slope where it is safe, keep the grass short so it never gets heavy, and trim the banks a mower cannot reach.

faqs.q: How much does mowing cost in Tuggeranong?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the block, the slope, the state of the lawn and what else is included, so we quote each lawn mowing Tuggeranong job individually. Quotes are free and upfront, and we will not guess a price without seeing the block.

faqs.q: Do you take the grass clippings and green waste away?
faqs.a: Yes. Green waste removal is available with every mowing visit, and with garden maintenance and clean-ups too. If you would rather keep some clippings for compost or mulch, tell us and we will leave what you want.
